values.meaning: Duration of the bonus attack damage/range and bolt-attack effect
values.quote: '''Twitch''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and {{sti|range|300 '''bonus''' attack range}} for 6 seconds

mechanics.claim: While active, Twitch's basic attacks are replaced by line-shaped bolts; Spray and Pray itself deals no separate on-cast damage instance.
mechanics.quote: his {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} are replaced by ''bolts'' that travel slightly further than his attack range in a straight line, dealing damage to {{tt|every enemy unit|non-champions and champions, wards and plants, turrets and structures}} hit.

mechanics.claim: A bolt deals 100% of the triggering attack's damage to the first enemy it hits, 10 percentage points less for each enemy already hit by that bolt, floored at 60%; against a single target a bolt always deals 100%.
mechanics.quote: formula=100% - 10% per enemy hit. ''This is capped at 60% damage.''

mechanics.claim: Spray and Pray's bolts apply on-hit effects and can critically strike, like a normal basic attack.
mechanics.quote: apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Twitch|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage.

mechanics.claim: Spray and Pray's cooldown starts on cast, not when its 6-second effect ends.
